piece.headline: ARORA SURVIVES, BHATIA CLOSES IN
piece.standfirst: Rajat Arora scraped through a poor week with the lead intact, but Yash Bhatia has eaten into it.
piece.big_picture: Rajat Arora stays top, but his captain blanked and the lead is down to 8. Yash Bhatia backed Haaland and closed in. Cherag lurks third. Another quiet armband and Rajat could find the door opening.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Shantanu swapped Sávio and Greaves for Tavernier and Konsa. That one move swung 20 points. Kartik's wrong 11 cost him 24 on the bench, but the Shantanu call was the sharper one.
piece.one_to_watch: Rajat Arora leads Yash Bhatia by 8 points. Last week it was 11. If Arora gets another blank armband, Bhatia could be level within a fortnight.

winners.name: Sukrut
winners.verdict: Haaland armband, Tavernier in, and a jump of 25 places. Nobody had a better week. Pure skill, with a dash of luck.

winners.name: Adwait
winners.verdict: Backed Haaland, banked the armband, and shot up 18 places. Not a clever differential, but you can't argue with the result.

winners.name: Apoorvo
winners.verdict: Backed the popular armband and collected the full 16. That left him 18 clear of the league average.

losers.name: Ketan
losers.verdict: Palmer got the armband and returned a negative score. Another 14 points sat on the bench. A proper shocker, and he's the one who picked it.

losers.name: Vidur
losers.verdict: The armband delivered for Vidur. The bench didn't: 11 points sat unused.

losers.name: Ajay
losers.verdict: Dropped 32 places, the biggest fall in the league. 10 points left on the bench didn't help. A brutal week with no obvious culprit.
